title: 3.0rc1 SMB disabled
symptom: SMBs are disabled in AAPS 3.0rc1 even though they are enabled in configuration. The user is using xDrip+ (slave) as the glucose source on the test system.
cause: The BG source (xDrip+ Sync Follower) does not support SMB always and the user does not enter carbs, so COB is always zero and SMB is forced disabled.
fix: Use a BG source that supports SMB always, or enter carbs to have COB > 0. The user notes that xDrip+ Sync Follower is not allowed as BG source for SMB.
evidence_quote: From what I see you are using BG source not supporting SMB always and you don't enter carbs. Thus COB is always zero and SMB is forced disabled
